title: Diversion by Scott Organ at The Barrow Group #diversionplay #thebarro...
transcript: Healthcare workers have always been overworked, but the Covid-19 pandemic was next level. Diversion by Scott Organ is a great new play that illustrates that toll, focusing on a group of ICU nurses and taking place entirely in their break room. The central plot concerns the tension and fallout from when some pills go missing. Not only is this a captivating premise, but it lays the groundwork on which we can see really clear character relationships and how a crisis impacts a workplace culture. The way everything unfolds is tightly crafted and well paced, with each scene meticulously placing another Tetris piece in the web of which characters are aware of which information. What really sells it is these actors — everyone is excellently cast and it's clear from the first few minutes that the synergy is there. All the characters feel recognizable but specific, and unequivocally in the same world — making it easy to be in their world with them. The Barrow Group is presenting Diversion through December 21st, and it's definitely worth checking out. With that, an adorably small program for my collection.
